editorialProfile.tone: curious, grounded nature and conservation journalism
editorialProfile.defaultCustomRequest: Create a photo-led, considered nature field journal with a strong documentary-photography rhythm, a clear editorial hierarchy, a useful explainer, a concise monthly chronology, source notes and a thoughtful closing page. Use only Publisher-screened documentary photographs supplied with their original credits and contextual captions. Never invent photography, misidentify a species, or present a contextual photograph as the image from a research paper or source article. Preserve all supplied reporting context. Use generous typography and a book-like mobile portrait composition. Do not pad pages.
